gen-gf-goldman-gf-puritan: Wide and brash, Goldman sets its letters far apart and rounds them like open parentheses, while Puritan stays soft and friendly below. The big, open counters in Puritan are what make this pair work.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada keeps its lowercase tall and full, with open curves, beneath the bold, constant-width lines of Grandstander. Paragraphs would move along smoothly, with no snags at the curves.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-supreme: Supreme sets a dense, heavy-looking band of crisp text, its letters held open rather than curled shut. But Happy Monkey is best at ruler-straight, one-tip simplicity, while Supreme is best at tidy, dense running text.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height and keeps a steady pressure through every smooth bend. Happy Monkey stays up top with ruler-straight lines, and the text below should read smoothly and without fuss.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-alexandr: Alexandria stands tall with wide-open terminals and short stems, set beneath the flat, sign-painter's-stencil lines of Love Ya Like A Sister. One brings loud flatness, the other quiet clarity, and the page holds together.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-anek-gur: Level and loud, Love Ya Like A Sister barely lifts its ascenders. Anek Gurmukhi gives every small letter big counters and open-handed curves, and that generosity is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-anek-lat: Anek Latin reads tall, its lowercase nearly touching the capitals. Beneath Love Ya Like A Sister, bent from a single length of wire, whole paragraphs would feel open and easy to move through.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-arimo: Arimo stands tall on a high mean line, with spacious gaps in its rounded letters, below Love Ya Like A Sister. Text beneath that loud heading stays open and unhurried.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-blinker: Blinker holds its line thickness and keeps wide apertures, with lowercase filling most of the height, beneath Love Ya Like A Sister. Nudging Blinker up a size or two would help it hold its own.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-carrois-: Barely lifted ascenders and outward-pointing tips give Love Ya Like A Sister its flat, bold look, while Carrois Gothic SC stays modest. One shouts, the other keeps curves open and caps close to lowercase.
